stemMd: A club has 240 members, 35% of whom are new. Of the new members, 25% bought a locker. How many new members bought a locker?
explanationMd: New membership is $0.35\times240=84$. A quarter of 84 is 21. Multiplying proportions is appropriate because the second percentage is conditional on being new.

distractorRationale.d: Adds the two percentages and applies the sum to all members.
